name: Factor large integer N using Catalog structural methods

description: Baseline: 7 factoring methods benchmarked on 16-48 bit balanced semiprimes. combined_structural (Pollard rho + small primes + Fermat) wins at 1.6ms for 48-bit. Pythagorean triple (Fermat) is 11ms. Trial division is 250ms.

v3 benchmark: rho_only=8.8ms@64bit balanced, channel-amp=33ms (overhead from interleaving). Catalog structural numbers factor in µs. Fermat fastest for very balanced small semiprimes. p-1 works for smooth factors. No O(1) classical method exists.
